articles.headline: QB Caleb Williams, WR Rome Odunze's chemistry helps Bears stun Lions
articles.description: QB Caleb Williams and WR Rome Odunze leaned on their chemistry and trust to secure Chicago's ninth win of the season.

images.name: Caleb Williams Rome Odunze [600x400]
images.caption: Bears WR Rome Odunze and QB Caleb Williams celebrate after Thursday's win. "When these big moments come up, it just tends to go to Rome," said Williams, who threw a go-ahead 6-yard TD pass to Odunze with three seconds left.
